answers.description: Physiotherapy for sports injuries, back pain and post-operative rehab, with clinics in Sheffield and Leeds. Evening appointments, and direct referrals from GPs and consultants.

about.body: We set up these clinics to help people recover from injury, pain and surgery. You'll find us in Sheffield and Leeds, with evening appointments available. Whether you're recovering from a sports injury, living with back pain, or working through rehab after an operation, we're here to help.

items.question: Do I need a referral to book?
items.answer: No, you can contact the clinic directly, or come through a referral from your GP or consultant.

items.question: Where are the clinics?
items.answer: We have clinics in both Sheffield and Leeds for you to choose from.

items.answer: Yes, evening appointments are available in both Sheffield and Leeds.
